**Recurring finding that appears in the most Healthcare‑Facility‑Inspection reports**  
- **Finding:** The Chief of Staff and Associate Director for Patient Care Services (or equivalent leaders) must develop written, service‑level workflows that describe each team member’s role in communicating test results, in line with VHA Directive 1088(1) – *“Communicating Test Results to Providers and Patients.”*  
- **How common it is:** This recommendation shows up in **21 of the 112 Healthcare Facility Inspection reports currently in scope** (≈ 19 % of all reports). The cluster’s prevalence is reported as “21 of 112 reports in scope”【0†data**】.  

**Is the VA El Paso Healthcare System part of that group?**  
No. The facilities listed in the cluster (e.g., VA Maryland Health Care System, VA Phoenix Health Care System, VA Nebraska‑Western Iowa Health Care System, VA Maine Healthcare System, VA Shreveport Healthcare System, VA West Texas Healthcare System, VA Albany Healthcare System, etc.) do not include the **VA El Paso Healthcare System**.  

Thus, the most‑frequent recurring finding is the need for written test‑result‑communication workflows, appearing in 21 reports, and the El Paso system is not among the facilities cited for this finding.
